A solution containing a mixture of $\text{Sn}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{Sn}^{4+}\text{(aq)}$ is added to a solution containing a mixture of $\text{Fe}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
Hexaaquairon(III) ions are pale violet. They form a colourless complex with fluoride ions, $\text{F}^-$, equilibrium **1**, and a deep-red complex with thiocyanate ions, $\text{SCN}^-$, equilibrium **2**.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Predict and explain the **sequence** of colour changes you would observe in each of the following experiments.

- A few drops of $\text{KSCN(aq)}$ are added to $5\text{cm}^3$ of $\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$, followed by a few drops of $\text{KF(aq)}$.

- A few drops of $\text{KF(aq)}$ are added to $5\text{cm}^3$ of $\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$, followed by a few drops of $\text{KSCN(aq)}$.
